steps.title: Prepare a charged object
steps.student_goal: Charge a sphere or select an already charged sphere for observation.
success_criteria: A sphere has a nonzero charge state.
The charged sphere is available for field-line observation.

steps.title: Observe one point charge
steps.student_goal: Observe field-line direction and density around one point charge.
success_criteria: Student observes field lines near and far from the charge.
Student connects line direction with force on a positive test charge.
Student connects denser field lines with stronger field.

steps.title: Compare two point charges
steps.student_goal: Use two point charges to reason about superposition.
success_criteria: Student compares field patterns for same-sign and opposite-sign charges.
Student explains that the net field is the vector sum of individual fields.
Student identifies where field strength is relatively stronger or weaker.
